title: Viewing panels.
officialText:
Viewing panels shall be provided in solid fences erected on or after July 1, 2013, at a rate one for every
25 linear feet (7.6 m) per frontage, with a minimum of one per frontage. Viewing panels shall be 12 inches by 12 inches (305 by
305 mm) in size and shall be blocked with plexiglass or an equivalent nonfrangible material. The top of the viewing panel shall be
located no more than 6 feet (1829 mm) above the level of the ground, and the bottom of the viewing panel shall be located no less
than 3 feet (914 mm) above the level of the ground.
